data.value: An account is where your money is kept, such as cash, a bank account or an e-wallet. You can add more later.

data.value: The PIN controls access to the app; it does not encrypt your data, which stays in your Windows user profile. Astra Finance can't recover a forgotten PIN, so choose one you'll remember.

data.name: Onboarding.Backup.Body
data.value: Automatic backups copy your data to a folder you choose. A folder on another drive or a synced folder adds extra safety.

data.name: Onboarding.Backup.Manual
data.value: You can also create a backup at any time with "Back up now" in the application menu (top right). Automatic backups keep the 10 most recent copies; manual backups are never deleted automatically.

data.name: Report.Income.Note
data.value: Includes all income transactions in the period. Transfers between your own accounts are not income. Deleted transactions are excluded.

data.value: Includes all expense transactions in the period, including transfer fees. Transfers between your own accounts are not expenses. Deleted transactions are excluded.

data.value: Balance at start + income - expenses + balance adjustments = balance at end, across all accounts. Transfers between your own accounts do not change the total and are not shown.

data.value: Opening = balance before the period starts; closing = balance at the end of the period. Inactive accounts are included so totals stay complete.

data.value: No allocations or releases in this period.

data.value: Allocations earmark money that is already in your accounts; they never change account balances. Negative amounts are releases.
